text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm at the movie theater with Shinko<n>Windy when
she stops in front of one<n>of the posters.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Check this out! The main<n>character of this
animated movie is a<n>wolf!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wolves are super cool! They've got<n>shiny fangs,
and they'll bite anyone<n>who messes with 'em.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Plus! In picture books and fairy tales,<n>wolves are
always the bad guys!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So I'm always lookin' forward to<n>seein' what
kinda evil deeds they're<n>gonna pull off! Ya get me?
choice_data_list: So you like them because they're villains.
So you like them because they're villains.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll have you know they're globalvillains—they've got the whole worldshakin' in their boots!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, I bet everyone who<n>watches this movie
will be shiverin'<n>in their seats the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: C'mon! We're watchin' this<n>together! Wahahaaa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What the heck did we just watch?!<n>Why was the
wolf a good guy?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whatcha leakin' tears all over theplace for?! Wolves are supposed tobe big and bad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How could I possibly feel scared? It<n>was a beautiful
movie about a<n>kindhearted wolf living peacefully
with a group of herbivores.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr! A wolf has to have more<n>villainous charisma!
choice_data_list: Surely there are good wolves out there too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Shut it! It's a million light-years too<n>early for a lowly
lackey to talk about<n>wolves like you know 'em!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Forget it! I'm gonna find someonewho gets it! I know that I'm notwrong about this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...And that's what happened. I'm<n>right, aren't I?
Wolves are supposed<n>to be fearsome!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't really care. Why are you<n>asking me about
wolves?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: 'Cause Pearl said you're a real lone<n>wolf!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And you're always chompin' on<n>some kinda meat!
So you gotta know<n>how wolves oughta be!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't have time for this.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't ignore me! Grrooowr!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, cool it with the biting. Geez...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I can't say much about wolves, but<n>they probably
don't go around<n>thinking of themselves as heroes
or<n>villains.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The way I see it, they have a defiant<n>fighting spirit
unique to their kind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
They keep their fangs sharp, ready to<n>tear into their
prey in an instant. That<n>savage nature is what
defines a wolf.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Were there any scenes like that in the<n>movie?
choice_data_list: The wolf did fight to protect his friends.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, you're right! That part was<n>super intense!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
He bared his fangs at a beast waaay<n>bigger than
him and went "Grrrr!" Talk<n>about chills! ...But I think
I get it now—a<n>wolf's gotta be brave!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I see potential in you. Let's<n>chat about
wolves again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll pass. Geez, Trainer, you sure<n>picked an oddball
to team up with.
choice_data_list: It never gets boring, that's for sure.
Who knew she was this into wolves?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wahaha, that's right! I'm incredible!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Not gonna even deny the "odd" part,<n>huh.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's 'cause ya lack wolf<n>knowledge! The three
of us have<n>some wolf studyin' to do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, don't lump me into this.
